seal.statement: Every proof the gate and continuous integration perform is produced once per push cycle and read everywhere else: each repository-health metric (complexity, cognitive complexity, import cycles, duplication, file size, unused exports) has one producing command whose report every consumer reads; the fixed test lists (the safety spine and the focused contracts) are one list run once; the sealed import graph has one producer and one reader that binds the seal; every whole-tree check declares the inputs that trigger it and runs only when they changed, in the shape of the existing full-corpus triggers; ESLint covers exactly the files of the pushed range at the pushed sha; repository-health's work is coalesced into the exact-sha ci run or removed; a proof-obligation registry extending the impact-contract registry is the one place an obligation (a fixed test, a whole-tree check, a witness) is declared with its inputs; the runner size, lane parallelism and timeouts of every workflow job follow a committed execution plan rather than per-workflow literals; and the behavioural canary is activated only when the gated run did not already run the whole corpus, with ci and repository-health under concurrency groups; the budget rows duplicate_metric_productions, duplicate_fixed_test_runs, import_graph_seal_readers_beyond_one, whole_tree_checks_without_input_trigger, eslint_off_pushed_range, repository_health_not_coalesced, workflows_without_concurrency, ci_resources_not_plan_driven and canary_after_full_corpus read zero, and every reduction cites the measurement it is compared against.
